lede: Georgia carries the stronger underlying team rating — +10.6 against +9.6, a 1.0-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Alabama -5.3 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Alabama winning 64% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Georgia leads Alabama by 77 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
